title: Create an API library
description: Creates an Angular API library inside an existing domain.

name.description: API library name, for example gateway.
name.x-prompt: What API name would you like to use?

domain.description: Existing domain name, for example booking. Omit this to place the library in shared.

directory.description: Optional nested path under the domain folder where the API library is created.

skipPrefix.description: Skip the api- prefix in the project name and folder.
